findings.title: Expand the courtyard-stroke residual inventory from the three named bottom pairs to all16 measured pairs

evidence.method: All209 footprint courtyards are closed axis-aligned rectangles,202 FP_RECT and7 four-segment rectangles. Compare actual stroked perimeter segment distance,not a body collision or only a filled AABB.

evidence.observation: The active inventory explicitly names C421/U12,R151/D121,R152/D121. The fresh whole-board sweep adds13 other stroked-perimeter pairs.

findings.maker_page_reason: This is native drawing/inventory evidence,not a violation of a numerical maker package limit.
findings.impact: Bounded drawing/deviation-inventory defect. Every measured native courtyard collision polygon and nominal body pair remains separate. No required-function failure or manufactured-clearance waiver is inferred.
findings.concrete_fix: Add the complete16-pair measured list to the current owner-deviation inventory and reconcile its count/location table. Any optional CAD cleanup must adjust only reviewed courtyard graphics through their source generators after pad/body containment checks,then rerun native DRC/fit; do not move pads or weaken fit limits to erase a drawing label.

findings.title: The separately owned vehicle candidate mirror still describes removed R10 hardware

evidence.observation: R10 candidate still names GH4 ports,an ARM terminal,GH2 J400 at(10.5,85.5),servo-era mating geometry and0.03mm GH margin.
J400 is outward-west DB125-2 at(7.4,65.85),23 contact positions belong to seven DB125 bodies,and J124/J123/GH ports/tie holes are absent.
The in-repository handoff correctly supplies current poses,support/SD/hardware/arming rules and explicitly warns that the parent mirror is stale.

findings.maker_page_reason: This is a cross-repository integration-record mismatch,not a maker-dimension failure.
findings.impact: A vehicle integrator reading the parent candidate entry can allocate obsolete plug/arming/switch envelopes. Current in-repository instructions already prevent treating that entry as qualified hardware,so this remains a bounded carried record defect.
findings.concrete_fix: In the separately authorized parent-document workflow,replace only the R10 candidate portion with docs/R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF.md facts,preserving the accepted R9 record. Until then retain the explicit stale-mirror warning; this read-only review does not edit that repository.

findings.title: Terminal tail coverage
findings.concrete_fix_observed: All23 native PTH positions now have separate collision-only pad-AABB/tail allocations; no extra mass is added for those rows. Actual solder/seating/bent tails remain physical inspection.

findings.title: Socket fitting nails and drawing tolerances
findings.concrete_fix_observed: Current generated/socket and separate mated boxes include the nails/tolerances. Common seating,card-front projection and actual assembly remain labelled Inference.

findings.title: Bottom hinge service on a continuous sled
findings.concrete_fix_observed: Current procedure expressly requires unpowered PCB unbolting/removal from the continuous sled,or a physically qualified hinge window. It no longer infers open-lid access from closed fit.

coverage_limits: No current-round peer reports/findings read; cached primary maker PDFs were independently inspected.
No git actions,native CLI invocation,GUI retry,canonical build,full check.sh,CAD/source change,or physical test. Only the assigned new reports and ignored probes were written.
Full DRC/ERC/parity/fabrication/build/firmware acceptance are outside this lens; six selected native mechanical rules are not a full gate.
Models are CAD allocations. Most inherited component models are nominal; no all-part manufactured maximum,warpage,seating,solder/coat/ferrule/tool sweep or as-built fit is certified.
Closed SD box does not dimension lid-opening travel; continuous-sled service requires unbolting/removing the unpowered board or a qualified window.
4mm default hardware leaves only0.145392mm nut/bore margin atx3.7 under the stated nominal nut/projection assumptions; actual hardware maxima/eccentricity remain unqualified.
Optional plate output is an inference with ideal supports,assumed stiffness/masses and a rigid sled. It is not a modal/shock/retention or500g proof.
Correctly disclosed pending qualification is retained as a limit,not counted as a demonstrated hardware failure. R9 remains accepted; this review does not accept/order R10.
